title: LiveActivationRequest
description: Phase F (operator-account-onboarding): input to LiveActivationWorkflow.activateLive. A server-side one-click live-activation request, machine-attributed to the authenticated operator. The workflow runs a fail-closed required-config gate + a fresh account probe and, on pass, emits a fresh LivePromotionApproved row (the gate-readable kind) so the already-wired order-time live-promotion gate keeps firing. Carries ZERO key material — credentials are resolved per-tenant by exec-svc at order time, never threaded through this request.

tenant_id.description: The tenant whose (tenant, strategy) live promotion is being activated.

strategy_id.description: The strategy being activated for live trading.

broker_target.description: The live broker_target being approved. Recorded in the LivePromotionApproved subject (the gate matches subject->>'broker_target') and used to route the fresh account probe to broker-<value>.

operator_id.description: The authenticated operator (X-Operator-Id) performing the one-click activation. Recorded as the machine-attributed approver in the emitted LivePromotionApproved subject (operator_id) — the single-operator substitute for the legacy dual-control approve().

expected_account_id.description: OPTIONAL. NOT supplied by the api-gateway caller — set by LiveActivationWorkflow after the fresh account probe (the probed brokerage account_number) and threaded into LivePromotionActivities.activate so it lands in the LivePromotionApproved subject (expected_account_id). Absent on the inbound request; populated server-side post-probe.
